2026_runoff.fact: 'Official Results for Primary Party Run-Off Election' (scan, page 1 read as image): 'Cumulative Results Report ... PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION ... Official Results ... Precincts Reporting 4 of 4 ... Run Time 11:24 AM Run Date 05/27/2026', county totals only; Last-Modified 01 Jun 2026 19:21 GMT. The link titled 'Unofficial Results Primary Run-Off Election.' opens a February 2026 notice file (Notice of Delivery of Balloting Materials, Last-Modified 10 Feb 2026). No per-precinct results posted.

rationale: Primary and runoff LATER (county totals only, posted after election night; no per-precinct results ever posted), 2024 undetermined, so COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, low.
